steps.label: four rows, each input addressable by its row id
the user types into rows 2 and 4 — text the app never stores, so only the element itself can carry it
seed a browser-owned marker on row 2; surviving the re-render is what says the same element is still mounted
drop the head — row 1 goes, and rows 2 and 4 keep both their element and their text
rotate — row 2 moves from first to last and takes its element, its marker and its text with it
focus survives a reorder natively: a keyed pass leaves the rows whose order already ascends exactly where they are

rotate again — 3 moves to the end, 4 and 2 keep their places, so the focused input is never re-attached. Fired directly rather than by clicking the button, which would take the focus this step is about
